kvr.desktop.consent.title: KVR: run the external program kvr-desktopd
kvr.desktop.consent.what: To show programs of this computer (terminal, browser, files) in KVR windows, the mod starts a separate program, kvr-desktopd. It runs with your user's rights and starts only what you pick in KVR.
kvr.desktop.consent.hidden: Apps run inside its hidden compositor: they have no windows on your real desktop and are visible only in Minecraft.
kvr.desktop.consent.private: Pixels never leave this computer: nothing is sent to the server or other players.
kvr.desktop.consent.stop: The program exits with the game. Consent is bound to the file's SHA-256: a different file asks again. Revoke it in the KVR settings.
kvr.desktop.consent.download: The file is missing. It will be downloaded from %s and started only if its hash matches:
kvr.desktop.consent.missing: The file is missing and no download is configured (host_desktop_download_url + host_desktop_download_sha256). Build native/kvr-desktopd and put the file at this path.
